explain: A deterministic toy encoder can test plumbing and vector shape without providing semantic understanding. The code explicitly uses character counts rather than a learned embedding.
steps: Convert two character counts into a tiny vector. || Observe its dimensions without interpreting the values as semantic quality.
name: embedding-shape

explain: Equal vector dimensions do not establish a compatible coordinate space. Query and index profiles must match before comparison or migration cutover.
steps: Compare complete representation profiles. || Reject a new query model against an old index despite identical dimensions.
name: vector-compatibility

explain: A provider may require distinct query and document modes. The adapter keeps that intent explicit instead of accidentally embedding both as the same task type.
steps: Construct separate request records. || Assert that the mode differs even when the source text is identical.
name: embedding-modes

explain: Validate count, dimension, numeric finiteness, and nonzero norm before publishing vectors. Python type hints do not validate provider output at runtime.
steps: Inspect every coordinate and dimension. || Reject the fixture containing a nonfinite value.
name: vector-validation

explain: Bounded admission prevents unbounded pending work. Control messages need a separate reserved path rather than being trapped behind a full ordinary queue.
steps: Fill a bounded data queue. || Reject another data item while still admitting cancellation through a separate control queue.
name: bounded-queue

explain: Report measured throughput and cost with explicit denominators, including failed work. Values are synthetic, not performance claims about a provider.
steps: Count all attempts and total elapsed time. || Divide total cost by completed tasks rather than excluding failed-call spend.
name: throughput-cost
journey-903
explain: A source-linked reasoning fixture. JSON parsing checks representation only; reproduce the actual mechanism with the chapter reference.
steps: Inspect the declared input and required invariant. || Trace the chapter mechanism and reproduce the stated case. || Change the stated assumption and defend the result.
expect: Reasoning input only; no program result is claimed. Reproduce the scenario using the chapter’s runnable reference.
limit: A JSON case is parsed for representation integrity only, not executed as a proof of its semantic claim.
